The build report’s focused **1/1** result remains separate from the **1,583 journal results**. The collector preserves that distinction correctly.

My execution was artifact reconciliation, hashing and binary-metadata inspection. I **did not compile or execute C#/PowerShell, restore gameplay saves, observe the workers live, or inspect the unarchived predecessor case artifacts**. Worker completion and absence are supported by the retained records, not my own process observation.
